QuestInfo.name: Embarking on the Dual Blade Path
QuestInfo.0: Ryden has some advice for those who choose the path of the Dual Blade. Go talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Dual Blades are a type of Thief that #bfight by dual-wielding daggers or blades#k. Their attacks are quick and strong. Unlike other Thieves, #rDual Blades begin their journey in the Secret Garden...#k Why could that be?\r\n\r\nThe path to unlock the full potential of a Dual Blade is a long one. Talk to Shiba at the Training Center to begin your training.
QuestInfo.2: You found Shiba at the Training Center.

0.0: You're kind of an oddball, aren't you, #h0#? Choosing to become a Dual Blade... Whelps, we'd better get you started.
0.1: To be a Dual Blade, there are just two things you need to know. First, #bwe dual-wield weapons#k. Second, #bLady Syl is our leader#k. Her word goes. Disobey her, and well, let's just say you can say buh-bye to some body parts.
0.2: Besides that, we're Thieves that stay in the shadows. We don't want the other Thieves in Kerning City to know we're around, because... Never mind, I'll fill you in on that later.
0.3: I hate to say this, but your arms look a little scrawny. How about you go get yourself some training? We have a guy who specializes in getting chicken-limbs like you up to speed.

yes.0: The guy's name is #bShiba#k, and the way he trains is lyrical, like poetry. Or that's the way he likes to describe it...

no.0: You're off to a poor start with an attitude like that.

1.0: A newcomer begins the Dual Blade journey with flabby abs and an empty head. It will require intense work, but I will train you to not be a disgrace to our order.

npc.0: Hey, buddy. If you can't find Shiba, just follow the arrow.
